rules: Label only what the website states. No outside knowledge. Copy quotes exactly. If pages disagree, record both as conflicting. If the site does not say, use not_found.
review_notes: Site's privacy policy is published under the legal entity name 'Axonwise Private Limited', operating the Sarvam AI brand -- noted here rather than used as the company_identity.name value, since the site brands itself as 'Sarvam'/'Sarvam AI' everywhere else. customers.industries was inferred from the sector affiliation of named customer logos (banks/NBFCs, e-commerce, government, insurance) rather than from an explicit on-site 'industries we serve' list, so it is marked inferred, not extracted -- flagged as a judgment call. pricing.public_plans is a representative subset of the full per-API rate card on the pricing page; many more line items (per-model LLM rates, additional Business-tier discounts) exist there. No on-site comparison/'vs competitor' page was found. B-51 (2026-09-27): customers.segments' evidence was a paraphrase ('Homepage customer logos and case studies span...'), not a literal quote; re-checked live and found no sentence anywhere on the real site states customer types/segments in words -- only the same implicit visual signal already used (more honestly, as an explicit inference) for customers.industries above: named customer logos and one Tata Capital testimonial, with no distinct customer-TYPE statement. Corrected to not_found per rule 4 rather than restate the industries inference under this field too.
